```lean
induction on the multiset Icc a b
case empty => 
  show Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) ∅ = Multiset.Icc (c + a) (c + b)
  simp [Multiset.Icc, Multiset.map]
case cons x xs =>
  obtain h : x ≤ b := by exact Icc.mem_iff.1 (Multiset.Icc.mem_iff.2 ⟨x, rfl⟩)
  have h1 : x = a := by rw [Icc.eq_iff.1 (Multiset.Icc.mem_iff.2 ⟨x, rfl⟩)]
  have h2 : xs = Icc a b \ {x} := by rw [Multiset.Icc.cons_eq]
  have h3 : x = a := h1
  have h4 : xs = Icc (a + 1) b := by rw [h2, Multiset.Icc.cons_eq]
  have h5 : Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) (x :: xs) = (c + x) :: Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) xs :=
    by simp [Multiset.map]
  have h6 : Multiset.Icc (c + a) (c + b) = (c + a) :: Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 1)) (c + b) :=
    by rw [Multiset.Icc.cons_eq, h3, h4]
  rw [h5, h6]
  induction xs using Multiset.induction_on with
    | nil => 
      show (c + x) :: ∅ = Multiset.Icc (c + a) (c + b)
      rw [Multiset.map, h3, h4]
    | cons y ys =>
      have h7 : y = a + 1 := by rw [Multiset.Icc.cons_eq, h4, Multiset.Icc.cons_eq]
      have h8 : ys = Icc (a + 1) b \ {y} := by rw [Multiset.Icc.cons_eq, h4, Multiset.Icc.cons_eq]
      have h9 : Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) (y :: ys) = (c + y) :: Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) ys :=
        by simp [Multiset.map]
      have h10 : Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 1)) (c + b) = (c + (a + 1)) :: Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 2)) (c + b) :=
        by rw [Multiset.Icc.cons_eq, h7, h8]
      rw [h9, h10]
      induction ys using Multiset.induction_on with
        | nil => 
          show (c + y) :: ∅ = Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 1)) (c + b)
          rw [Multiset.map, h7, h8]
        | cons z zs =>
          have h11 : z = a + 2 := by rw [Multiset.Icc.cons_eq, h8, Multiset.Icc.cons_eq]
          have h12 : zs = Icc (a + 2) b \ {z} := by rw [Multiset.Icc.cons_eq, h8, Multiset.Icc.cons_eq]
          have h13 : Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) (z :: zs) = (c + z) :: Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) zs :=
            by simp [Multiset.map]
          have h14 : Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 2)) (c + b) = (c + (a + 2)) :: Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 3)) (c + b) :=
            by rw [Multiset.Icc.cons_eq, h11, h12]
          rw [h13, h14]
          induction zs using Multiset.induction_on with
            | nil => 
              show (c + z) :: ∅ = Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 2)) (c + b)
              rw [Multiset.map, h11, h12]
            | cons w ws =>
              have h15 : w = a + 3 := by rw [Multiset.Icc.cons_eq, h12, Multiset.Icc.cons_eq]
              have h16 : ws = Icc (a + 3) b \ {w} := by rw [Multiset.Icc.cons_eq, h12, Multiset.Icc.cons_eq]
              have h17 : Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) (w :: ws) = (c + w) :: Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) ws :=
                by simp [Multiset.map]
              have h18 : Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 3)) (c + b) = (c + (a + 3)) :: Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 4)) (c + b) :=
                by rw [Multiset.Icc.cons_eq, h15, h16]
              rw [h17, h18]
              induction ws using Multiset.induction_on with
                | nil => 
                  show (c + w) :: ∅ = Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 3)) (c + b)
                  rw [Multiset.map, h15, h16]
                | cons v vs =>
                  have h19 : v = a + 4 := by rw [Multiset.Icc.cons_eq, h16, Multiset.Icc.cons_eq]
                  have h20 : vs = Icc (a + 4) b \ {v} := by rw [Multiset.Icc.cons_eq, h16, Multiset.Icc.cons_eq]
                  have h21 : Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) (v :: vs) = (c + v) :: Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) vs :=
                    by simp [Multiset.map]
                  have h22 : Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 4)) (c + b) = (c + (a + 4)) :: Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 5)) (c + b) :=
                    by rw [Multiset.Icc.cons_eq, h19, h20]
                  rw [h21, h22]

                    | nil => 
                      show (c + v) :: ∅ = Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 4)) (c + b)
                      rw [Multiset.map, h19, h20]

                      have h24 : us = Icc (a + 5) b \ {u} := by rw [Multiset.Icc.cons_eq, h20, Multiset.Icc.cons_eq]
                      have h25 : Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) (u :: us) = (c + u) :: Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) us :=
                        by simp [Multiset.map]
                      have h26 : Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 5)) (c + b) = (c + (a + 5)) :: Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 6)) (c + b) :=
                        by rw [Multiset.Icc.cons_eq, h23, h24]
                      rw [h25, h26]

                          rw [Multiset.map, h23, h24]

                          have h29 : Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) (t :: ts) = (c + t) :: Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) ts :=

                          have h30 : Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 6)) (c + b) = (c + (a + 6)) :: Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 7)) (c + b) :=
                            by rw [Multiset.Icc.cons_eq, h27, h28]
